h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Machilipatnam

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Machilipatnam

c: Machilipatnam is an old port town on the Bay of Bengal, known for its kalamkari printing, and the sea is never far from any site here. FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor gym equipment in Machilipatnam to schools, colleges, municipal parks and residential layouts. We manufacture every machine in Vasai, about 940 km away, and send it to coastal Andhra by road.

Two things matter most on this coast. Salt air settles on metal all year, and cyclones and heavy rain can arrive from October to December. We galvanise every frame for this reason and suggest a fresh-water rinse every few weeks for machines near the beach. Grouting each machine into a concrete footing keeps it firm in strong wind and wet ground. Our installation team or a dealer in south India carries out the fixing.

items.q: How do we protect outdoor gym machines from sea air in Machilipatnam?
items.a: Rinse them with fresh water every few weeks, tighten loose bolts and keep sand off the base. The galvanised coating protects the steel, and regular cleaning helps it last.

items.q: What should we do after a cyclone or heavy storm?
items.a: Check each machine for loose bolts or damage before anyone uses it. Clear debris from the base, and call our after-sales team on +91 738 530 0921 if a part needs replacing.

items.q: Do you deliver to coastal Andhra Pradesh?
items.a: Yes. We dispatch from our Vasai factory by road and install through our own team or a dealer in south India, using grouting or self-standing fixing as the ground needs.
